layout: contiguous [batch, heads, sequence, channels] storage buffers
semantics: softmax(Q @ K.T / sqrt(head_dim) + optional additive mask) @ V
mask: Optional finite FP32 [1 or batch, 1, 1, key_length], broadcast across heads and queries. Finite additive masks, including -10000, are supported; boolean masks, infinities, causal mode and dropout are outside this prototype contract.

bindings.4: mask (one float dummy buffer if absent)

push_constants: 8 uint32, in order: query_length, key_length, head_dim, value_dim, heads, batches, mask_batch_stride, use_mask
integration_requirement: Standalone source experiment only. A graph rewrite and packing/conversion measurements are required before inference integration or production qualification. Compare against pinned stock attention with the same inputs and include boundary conversion costs.
